headword: ご{指導|しどう}ご{鞭撻|べんたつ}

definitions.explanation: A set phrase asking a superior, teacher or senior colleague to keep guiding and encouraging the speaker. Used in formal greetings, speeches and letters.

examples.japanese: ご{指導|しどう}ご{鞭撻|べんたつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I ask for your guidance and encouragement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧ともご{指導|しどう}ご{鞭撻|べんたつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほど、⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I humbly ask for your continued guidance and encouragement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦たいてい→たいてい：01129_taitei⟧「ご{指導|しどう}ご{鞭撻|べんたつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほど」⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{締|し}めくくられる。
examples.english: A new employee's self-introduction usually ends with "I ask for your guidance and encouragement."

notes:
Heard at the end of self-introductions by new employees, new teachers or people taking up a post, and written at the end of formal letters. {鞭撻|べんたつ} literally means whipping, figuratively urging someone on.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧ともご{指導|しどう}ご{鞭撻|べんたつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほど⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧: I ask for your continued guidance (fixed closing)
- ご{鞭撻|べんたつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{賜|たまわ}ります→賜る：07659_tamawaru⟧よう: so that I may receive your encouragement (very formal)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧: guidance, instruction
